reference: Evaluate both Cartesian Fourier flux phasors at 63 interior targets using minus the conductivity times the analytic gradient of two oblique waves plus the prescribed polynomial. Compare each component independently. Radial disk Bessel fields, purely polynomial fields, and a near-panel comparison with the centered numerical temperature derivative provide additional checks.
